Title: Add boundary codec tests and assert rejection of unconsumed sequence nodes

Several codec boundaries remain green when deliberately changed. Add 12 tests covering length forms, primitive indefinite BER, NULL contents, BOOLEAN values and serialization, unsigned INTEGER rejection, BIT STRING padding counts, encoded DEFAULT, the UTCTime 1950 boundary, empty constructed BER octets, and integer-byte index ordering. Extend `testUTF8StringCanCreateAString` (ASN1StringTests.swift:153), which covers ASCII only, with non-ASCII byte and String conversion checks.

Repair `testSequenceMustConsumeAllNodes` with `XCTAssertThrowsError`. Previously, unexpected decoding success left its rejection check green; its child-decoding assertions remain useful. Tests follow the existing file layout, annotate malformed inputs and check error codes. The PR contains 15 proposed cases: 12 new test methods, two checks in one existing UTF8String test, and one missing rejection assertion repair.

Credit for that case belongs to #132; it is omitted here. Mutant 21 fires only on input byte 79. The duplicate sequence discriminator remains package evidence only.
